newsitem.title: UK: Argentina to launch $750 mln seven-yr global bond.
newsitem.headline: Argentina to launch $750 mln seven-yr global bond.

text.p: Argentina said in a statement on Monday it will launch a $750 million seven-year global bond in the near future.
"Argentina anticipates that it will sell $750 million of notes with a maturity of seven years," the statement said.
Credit Suisse First Boston and SBC Warburg will be joint lead managers, the statement said.
No further terms of the proposed dollar deal were given.
Argentina was last in the international capital markets on July 11 with a 750 billion lire 10-year offering.
